text:
tess: Quick check — OrbitEdge POC timeline kickoff. Sales wants a go/no-go by next Tue. Can we confirm owners for infra, API contract, and demo data?

sam: I can own infra (staging cluster + VPC peering). Need network team approval for peering and a target IP range. ETA Tue EOD for provisioning if approvals are quick.

maya: I’ll take API contract and acceptance tests. Can someone paste the customer schema for messages? don’t have it in the ticket.

jin: I have the schema in the google doc — linking: https://go.redwood/orbitedge-schema (read-only). Main gap: they expect streaming partial responses for long transcripts. We should confirm model variant supports streaming.

lucy: Devex note — demo will need a stable API key that won’t rotate during trial. SEs asked for a long-lived key tied to the staging org. Sam, can you request a service key from secrets for the pilot org?

sam: Yep, will request KMS-backed key. FYI Dedicated keys require E2E approval; for now we'll issue single staging key scoped to orbit-edge-pilot.

tess: Success criteria from sales: 1) <200ms median token latency on 2k seq for 95% of requests, 2) embeddings match vendor baseline within 2% MRR on sample set, 3) no auth errors for 72h. Anything else?

maya: Add: structured output fields must be present (intent, entities, confidence). We’ll include a few JSON-based golden prompts in the acceptance tests.

jin: Dependency: customer will send PII data for mapping; we need a redaction step in the pipeline. Who owns that?

lucy: Research/ops can implement a lightweight redact filter in the preprocessor. I can prototype and drop a containerized step by Friday.

sam: Network question — will they connect from their on-prem IP or via our hosted flow? We need CIDRs for peering if on-prem.

tess: They’ll start with hosted API and later request VPC peering for production. For the POC, hosted flow is fine but we need the peering plan ready if they ask.

maya: Code-review ping: I opened a tiny PR for the acceptance-test harness (https://git.redwood/r/integration/orbit-acceptance/pull/12). @jin @lucy PTAL — it wires the redact step and streaming assertions.

jin: On it. I’ll look today and flag any infra mocks needed.

lucy: Quick comment on the PR — we should add a toggle to run redact in CI only for this POC. Don’t want it in global pipeline yet.

sam: Timeline recap: infra reqs by Tue EOD, staging key by Wed midday, acceptance tests ready by Thu, dry-run demo Fri. Is that aligned with sales?

tess: Sales confirmed dry-run Fri AM. Customer demo Mon the following week. So this timeline works.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: orbit-edge-dryrun-deploy -> Fri 09:00 UTC. Link: https://ci.redwood/jobs/12345

maya: Blocking items I have: customer sample set (PII redaction coverage), final schema sign-off, and expected embedding baseline values. Sales to provide.

jin: Also need a sample of long transcripts for streaming verification — if they only send short messages we won’t validate latency correctly.

sam: I’ll add a network ticket for peering plan (NET-4583) and the secrets request (SEC-7890).

lucy: I’ll drop a prototype redact container image to the staging registry and share the image tag in this thread when done.

tess: Owners recap in one line each: infra -> sam, API/tests -> maya, streaming + PR review -> jin, redaction proto -> lucy. Sales to deliver sample data and embedding baselines.

maya: Thanks — I’ll follow up with the acceptance test checklist and link it here once PR merges.

jin: Reviewing PR now. If no major comments, we can merge and start CI runs.

tess: Appreciate it. If anything slips, flag here and we’ll ask sales to push the dry-run. :thumbsup:

sam: noted. ping me @sam if you need approvals for peering.

lucy: image pushed: gcr.redwood/staging/redact:orbitedge-v1 — will add CI hook by EOD.

maya: Got it — will wire the image into the harness.

tess: Perfect. Closing loop — I’ll update the sales playbook with owners and publish the dry-run invite. Thanks team.
